import nltk
from string import punctuation
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Constants
PUNCTUATION = set(punctuation)

from collections import Counter


def task_func(text):
    if not text:
        return None

    tokens = str(text).split()

    def is_valid(token):
        return token.startswith("$") and not all(ch in PUNCTUATION for ch in token)

    valid_tokens = [token for token in tokens if is_valid(token)]

    if not valid_tokens:
        return None

    counts = Counter(valid_tokens)
    items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
    words = [word for word, _ in items]
    freqs = [freq for _, freq in items]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(6, len(words) * 0.8), 4))
    sns.barplot(x=words, y=freqs, ax=ax, color="blue")
    ax.set_xlabel("Words")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.set_title("Frequency of words beginning with '$'")
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right")
    plt.tight_layout()
    return ax
